English සිංහල தமிழ் Fact Checked All Economy Society Environment Politics Health Methodology About Us Explore Fact-Checking Contact Us #fakenews Actress Sai Pallavi’s wedding news is not true False A post on one of her social media fan pages, ‘Sai Pallavi Fandom’, has posted that South Indian film actress Sai Pallavi is married. by Anonymous | October 9, 2023 Sai Pallavi Fandom’ has shared a message on its homepage saying that she is married to director Rajkumar Periasamy, along with a picture of Sai Pallavi and Rajkumar happily posing with garlands. Factseeker was able to observe that this photo is being shared more and more on social media, and more messages are being shared congratulating them both on their marriage. What is the truth? This photo is the opening pooja event for a new movie directed by Rajkumar Periyasamy. Tamil actor Sivakarthikeyan is starring in this movie, and Sai Pallavi is playing the female lead. January 11, 2024 Reliable Verified News. Delivered to You. We are an independent fact-checking team affiliated with the Sri Lanka Press Institute(SLPI). The objective and long-term goal of the FactSeeker is to provide the public with reliable and verified content in the attempt of debunking mis/disinformation. The unit, with the SLPI, is committed to contributing to improved media literacy in Sri Lanka.
